**Registration is open** — registration and payment run through the ETH Zürich event registration platform. **Abstract submission is open** until **15 June 2027**; decisions in early July 2027.

::: {.reg-actions}
[Register now →](https://ethzurich.eventsair.com/2nd-perit-summit/regi/Site/Register){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg} [Submit an abstract](#abstract){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#abstract-modal" role="button"}
:::

::: {.callout-important}
## Abstracts and registration are separate
Submitting an abstract does **not** register you for the Summit. Places are limited to **around 90 participants**, so we recommend registering now — you do not need to wait for the abstract decision. Note that early-bird registration closes on 15 June 2027, the same day as the abstract deadline.
:::

The Peritoneal Summit is kept deliberately intimate — **around 90 participants** — to encourage genuine exchange across disciplines.

## Key dates

| Date | Milestone |
|---|---|
| **Now open** | Registration |
| **15 June 2027** | Abstract submission deadline · early-bird registration closes |
| **Early July 2027** | Abstract decisions communicated |
| **Mid-August 2027** | Accommodation booking deadline — limited rooms at the venue, book early |
| **Until the conference** | Regular registration remains open, subject to capacity |

All prices in CHF, including VAT. The early-bird rate applies until **15 June 2027**; the regular rate applies from 16 June 2027 until the Summit, subject to capacity. Accommodation is not included in the conference packages. You can book a room at Hotel Seaside as part of your registration: you pay the conference package online when you register, and the hotel directly on arrival.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Beware of accommodation scams
Rooms at Hotel Seaside are booked only as part of your registration and paid at the hotel on arrival. Conference fees are paid only through the ETH Zürich registration platform linked on this page. **We never ask for advance payment for accommodation, and we do not work with any housing agency or travel bureau.** If someone contacts you offering rooms or registration for the Peritoneal Summit, it is not from us — please do not pay, and let us know via the [Contact](contact.qmd) page.
:::

## Questions

For questions about registration or abstracts, contact the organizers (see [Contact](contact.qmd)).

::: {.modal-body}
Deadline **15 June 2027** · decisions in early July 2027. Submitting an abstract does not register you — please [register](https://ethzurich.eventsair.com/2nd-perit-summit/regi/Site/Register) separately.

[Guidelines & instructions ▾](#af-guidelines){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-secondary data-bs-toggle="collapse" role="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="af-guidelines"}

::: {#af-guidelines .collapse .af-guidelines}
**What we are looking for.** The Summit welcomes contributions across the full breadth of peritoneal research and technology, including but not limited to:

- Peritoneal immunity and tissue repair
- Peritoneal carcinomatosis, metastasis, and surgical oncology
- Endometriosis and peritoneal pathology
- Peritoneal dialysis, fibrosis, and mesothelial-to-mesenchymal transition
- Imaging, single-cell, and spatial methods
- Biomaterials, surgical mesh, and adhesion prevention
- Translational and clinical studies

**Format.** The 2025 edition included oral presentations selected from submitted abstracts, a flash-talk session, and a poster session. We anticipate a similar format for 2027.

**Awards.** Best-poster and best-talk awards will be granted, as they were at the 2025 Summit. Students and early-career researchers are especially encouraged to submit.

**How to send.** Abstracts are limited to 500 words. Pressing **Send by email** opens a pre-filled email in your mail program, addressed to abstracts@peritoneal-summit.com — just press send. If no mail program opens, use **Copy text** and send it to [abstracts@peritoneal-summit.com](mailto:abstracts@peritoneal-summit.com) with the subject "Abstract submission". You will receive a confirmation once we have it.
:::

```{=html}
<form id="abstract-form" class="abstract-form" novalidate>
  <div class="row g-3">
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="af-name">Presenting author *</label><input class="form-control" id="af-name" required></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="af-email">Email *</label><input class="form-control" id="af-email" type="email" required></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="af-affil">Institution *</label><input class="form-control" id="af-affil" required></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="af-stage">Career stage</label>
      <select class="form-select" id="af-stage"><option>Student (undergraduate / graduate)</option><option>Postdoc / early-career</option><option>Group leader / faculty</option><option>Clinician</option><option>Industry</option><option>Other</option></select></div>
    <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label" for="af-authors">All authors and affiliations</label><input class="form-control" id="af-authors" placeholder="e.g. A. Author¹, B. Author² — ¹University of …, ²…"></div>
    <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label" for="af-title">Abstract title *</label><input class="form-control" id="af-title" required></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="af-format">Preferred format</label>
      <select class="form-select" id="af-format"><option>Oral or poster</option><option>Oral</option><option>Poster</option></select></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label" for="af-topic">Topic</label>
      <select class="form-select" id="af-topic"><option>Peritoneal immunity and tissue repair</option><option>Peritoneal carcinomatosis, metastasis, and surgical oncology</option><option>Endometriosis and peritoneal pathology</option><option>Peritoneal dialysis, fibrosis, and MMT</option><option>Imaging, single-cell, and spatial methods</option><option>Biomaterials, surgical mesh, and adhesion prevention</option><option>Translational and clinical studies</option><option>Other</option></select></div>
    <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label" for="af-text">Abstract * <span class="af-count" id="af-count">0 / 500 words</span></label>
      <textarea class="form-control" id="af-text" rows="10" required placeholder="Background, methods, results, conclusion — max. 500 words"></textarea></div>
  </div>
  <p class="af-msg" id="af-msg" role="status"></p>
  <div class="af-actions">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Send by email</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" id="af-copy">Copy text</button>
  </div>
</form>
<script>
(function () {
  var TO = "abstracts@peritoneal-summit.com", MAXW = 500;
  var f = document.getElementById("abstract-form"), msg = document.getElementById("af-msg");
  var v = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id).value.trim(); };
  var words = function (t) { return t ? t.split(/\s+/).length : 0; };
  var txt = document.getElementById("af-text"), cnt = document.getElementById("af-count");
  txt.addEventListener("input", function () {
    var n = words(txt.value.trim()); cnt.textContent = n + " / " + MAXW + " words";
    cnt.classList.toggle("over", n > MAXW);
  });
  function check() {
    var miss = ["af-name", "af-email", "af-affil", "af-title", "af-text"].filter(function (id) { return !v(id); });
    if (miss.length) { msg.textContent = "Please fill in all fields marked *."; document.getElementById(miss[0]).focus(); return false; }
    if (words(v("af-text")) > MAXW) { msg.textContent = "The abstract is over " + MAXW + " words."; txt.focus(); return false; }
    msg.textContent = ""; return true;
  }
  function body() {
    return "ABSTRACT SUBMISSION — Peritoneal Summit 2027\n\n" +
      "Presenting author: " + v("af-name") + "\nEmail: " + v("af-email") + "\nInstitution: " + v("af-affil") +
      "\nCareer stage: " + v("af-stage") + "\nAll authors: " + v("af-authors") +
      "\nPreferred format: " + v("af-format") + "\nTopic: " + v("af-topic") +
      "\n\nTitle: " + v("af-title") + "\n\n" + v("af-text") + "\n";
  }
  function subject() { return "Abstract submission: " + v("af-title"); }
  f.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault(); if (!check()) return;
    window.location.href = "mailto:" + TO + "?subject=" + encodeURIComponent(subject()) + "&body=" + encodeURIComponent(body());
    msg.textContent = "Your mail program should open with the abstract filled in — please press send there. Nothing opened? Use “Copy text”.";
  });
  document.getElementById("af-copy").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (!check()) return;
    var t = "To: " + TO + "\nSubject: " + subject() + "\n\n" + body();
    (navigator.clipboard ? navigator.clipboard.writeText(t) : Promise.reject()).then(
      function () { msg.textContent = "Copied. Paste it into an email to " + TO + "."; },
      function () { msg.textContent = "Copying failed — please select and copy the abstract manually and email it to " + TO + "."; });
  });
  var m = document.getElementById("abstract-modal");
  if (["#abstract", "#submit"].indexOf(window.location.hash) >= 0 && window.bootstrap) {
    bootstrap.Modal.getOrCreateInstance(m).show();
  }
})();
</script>
```
